name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A keyboard key or shortcut, shown as a small keycap.

props.name: children
props.description: The key name or symbol, e.g. "Esc", "⌘", "↵".

props.name: children
props.description: Kbd elements, optionally with separators such as "+" or "then".

notes: Renders <kbd>; KbdGroup is a <kbd> containing <kbd>s, the HTML idiom for a key combination.
Symbols such as ⌘ and ↵ are read inconsistently by screen readers; spell the shortcut out nearby or in an aria-label on the control it belongs to (aria-keyshortcuts).
Key combinations stay in pressing order (left to right) on right-to-left pages.

do: Use the platform's key names (⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere).
dont: Don't use Kbd for code or values — use <code>.
